DAY BY DAY.

14—21 OCT
01 / 14—15 OCT

OSAKA

14WED
OSAKAKIX → Namba

ARRIVAL / NEON NIGHTS

KIX arrival 13:20 · Nankai Railway toward Namba · check-in at Dormy Inn PREMIUM Namba ANNEX. Evening: Kuromon Market, Dotonbori canal, Shinsaibashi, street food and izakaya.

Dotonbori · Shinsaibashi
15THU
OSAKALocal metro / walk

ELECTRONICS / STREET CULTURE

Den Den Town in Nipponbashi for tech, games and retro electronics. Shinsekai for food and atmosphere, Umeda for larger shops, then return to Namba for dinner.

Den Den Town · Shinsekai · Umeda
02 / 16 OCT

KYOTO

16FRI
KYOTOOsaka → Kyoto

OLD STREETS / NEW CITY

Morning transfer Osaka → Kyoto; leave bags at hotel near Kyoto Station. Nishiki Market, Kiyomizu-dera, Sannenzaka, Ninenzaka, Gion and Pontocho in the evening.

Nishiki · Higashiyama · Gion
03 / 17 OCT

HAKONE

17SAT
HAKONEKyoto → Odawara → Hakone

SHRINES / ONSEN

Early Fushimi Inari if time permits. Shinkansen Kyoto → Odawara, then local rail to Hakone-Yumoto. Check in to a public-onsen hotel or ryokan. Dinner in town.

Fushimi Inari · Onsen
04 / 18—21 OCT

TOKYO

18SUN
TOKYOHakone → Odawara → Tokyo

MOUNTAINS / METROPOLIS

Hakone sightseeing depending on weather and time: Gora, Owakudani ropeway, Lake Ashi and possible Fuji views. Continue via Odawara to Tokyo; evening around hotel.

Owakudani · Lake Ashi
19MON
TOKYOTokyo local

GADGETS / VINTAGE

Akihabara electronics, audio, gaming and retro gadgets. Continue to Ueno and Ameyoko for vintage shopping, then Shinjuku and Omoide Yokocho for dinner.

Akihabara · Ameyoko · Shinjuku
20TUE
TOKYOTokyo local

DESIGN / STREETWEAR

Harajuku, Cat Street, Omotesando and Shibuya: sneakers, clothing, vintage and interesting design stores. Nightlife and izakaya in Shibuya or Shinjuku.

Harajuku · Shibuya
21WED
DEPARTURETokyo → Narita NRT

LAST HOURS / NARITA

Easy breakfast, checkout and a short final walk or shopping stop. Allow generous transfer time to Narita Airport for MU522 at 16:55.

Flight at 16:55
BILDER / Die Fotokacheln sind für die Offline-Nutzung eingebettet. Das Shibuya-Nachtbild zeigt die Kreuzung aus erhöhter Perspektive.

THE FIELD GUIDE IS A CURATED SHORTLIST, NOT A LIVE AVAILABILITY CHECK. OPENING HOURS AND PRICES MAY CHANGE. MAPS AND WEB LINKS REQUIRE INTERNET.

FIELD NOTES.

FOOD / SHOPS / TRANSIT
01 / EAT

AFTER DARK.

Yakiniku, sushi and sashimi, yakitori, ramen, small izakaya and counter dining.

  • Osaka: Dotonbori, Namba, Shinsekai
  • Kyoto: Nishiki, Gion, Pontocho
  • Hakone: dinner around Hakone-Yumoto
  • Tokyo: Omoide Yokocho, Shinjuku, Shibuya
02 / DISCOVER

FIND THE GOOD STUFF.

Tech, gadgets, cycling, sneakers, vintage clothing, retro electronics and Classic Mini culture.

  • Osaka: Den Den Town, Shinsaibashi
  • Tokyo: Akihabara, Ameyoko
  • Tokyo: Harajuku, Cat Street, Shibuya
  • Look out for secondhand and specialty stores
03 / TRANSIT

MOVE SMART.

KIX → Namba by Nankai. Osaka → Kyoto by rail. Kyoto → Odawara by Tokaido Shinkansen. Hakone-Yumoto via local train; continue to Tokyo via Odawara.

JAPAN GUIDE ↗HAKONE PASS ↗
04 / TO DO

BEFORE TAKEOFF.

  • Confirm Hakone hotel for 17 Oct
  • Confirm Tokyo hotel for 18–21 Oct
  • Check seat reservations and luggage policy
  • Verify airport and transfer times
  • Check onsen rules and Hakone weather
